_comment: This is a PLACEHOLDER. Never commit real google-services.json files.
Obtain the real file from the Firebase console for each environment:
TST:  Firebase console → exchangapay-tst  → Project settings → google-services.json
PROD: Firebase console → exchangapay-prod → Project settings → google-services.json
File placement (the Google Services Gradle plugin picks these up automatically):
Both per-config files are gitignored. The Gradle H-15 guard will fail a
production release build if the prod file is missing or still points at the tst project.
